rationale: The protobuf field 'name' was renamed to 'display_name' on wire field 2. Protobuf JS/TS codegen converts snake_case field names to camelCase accessors, so the generated TypeScript property changes from 'name' to 'displayName'. Two locations in main.ts reference this field: line 13 reads the decoded value for observations, and line 83 constructs a test EntityV1. Both are updated to use the new property name 'displayName' and the new observation key 'display_name' per the intended behavior.
assumptions: Protobuf TS codegen uses camelCase for field accessors (displayName for display_name)
Regenerated bindings for v1 Entity expose 'displayName' property
v2 Entity schema is unchanged and does not have this field
Observation key must be 'display_name' (snake_case) as specified
